description.describe_ch: 本課程介紹了確定企業收入和財務狀況所必需的概念和分析。 該課程將介紹基本的會計框架，然後繼續教授用於記錄公司交易並最終生成財務報表的原則和技術。 財務報表是公司用來向各種用戶群體（包括經理、投資者和債權人）報告其活動結果的商業文件，而這些各方又使用財務報表來做出各種決策，例如是否投資 或借錢給公司。 成功完成本課程的學生將能夠準備、理解和分析財務報告和相關會計領域的知識，這對商業決策至關重要。
description.describe_eh: This course provides an introduction to concepts and analysis essential to determining the income and financial position of a business. The course will introduce the basic accounting framework and then proceed to teach principles and techniques used to record the company's transactions and to ultimately produce the financial statements. Financial statements are the business documents that companies use to report the results of their activities to various user groups, including managers, investors and creditors, In turn, these parties use the financial statements to make a variety of decisions, such as whether to invest in or loan money to the company. The student who successfully completes this class will be able to prepare, understand and analyze financial reports and knowledge in relevant fields of accounting essential to decision making in business.

Learning must be based on honesty. Any student who attempts to use a work that he has not produced as his own is considered dishonest. Students who cheat or plagiarize in homework, tests or exams, or assist others, will be scored as zero. If they are repeat offenders, they will be submitted in accordance with the rewards and punishments for students of Feng Chia University.
